Absolutely, educating your audience about the cultural contributions of classic Bollywood films can offer them a richer viewing experience. It’s great that you’re considering integrating their aesthetic and stylistic significance as well. This multidimensional approach could really enhance your critiques. Your approach to balancing nostalgia with analysis is insightful. It reflects a deep understanding of how these films have shaped Indian cinema. The storytelling and cultural narratives are particularly compelling. They offer insights into the social and cultural contexts of the time.

It’s wonderful that you’re focusing on these aspects to highlight their significance.
